title: Maximum Lot Coverage
previewText: For developments or enlargements of residences, the maximum lot coverage regulations are set forth in Section 23-361 for R1 through R5 Districts and Section 23-362 for R6 through R12 Districts. Special rules for certain interior or through lots are set forth in Section 23-363.
